_comment: Weapons (docs/COMBAT.md). Order = the number keys: the first entry is weapon 1, the second weapon 2, the third weapon 3. kind: projectile | beam | missile. Missiles (ammo, no heat): damage = blast centre damage falling off linearly to 0 at blast_radius (to the rock surface); thrust m/s^2 along the nose for fuel_seconds; turn_rate deg/s; lifetime = self-destruct seconds; arm_distance units before it can detonate; fuse_radius proximity fuse around the locked target; nav_gain = proportional navigation N; launch_kick m/s on top of the ship velocity. damage per bolt; speed m/s relative to the shooter (bolts inherit the ship's velocity on top); lifetime seconds; range = beam length; rate_of_fire shots per second; heat_per_shot / heat_per_second add heat 0..1; cooldown_rate heat lost per second; overheat_lockout_seconds = cannot fire this long after overheating; recoil = m/s of ship speed per shot; spread = cone half angle in degrees; muzzle = [right, up, forward] offset in the ship frame; colour [r,g,b]; beam_dps damage per second on asteroids. Missing fields keep the built-in value.
